Get Voice
This API supports querying all available voice IDs (voice_id) under the current account. This includes system voices, clone voices, voice design voices and vocal voices from the music generation api.
API Introduction
API：https://api.minimax.io/v1/get_voice
Request Parameters
AuthorizationstringRequired
HTTP：Bearer Auth
- Security Scheme Type: http
- HTTP Authorization Scheme: Bearer API_key
voice_typestringRequired
The following values are supported:
"system" (system voices),
"voice_cloning" (quick cloned voices),
"voice_generation" (voices generated by voice design api),
"music_generation" (vocal voices generated by music generation api),
"all" (all of the above).
Request Sample
Copy
import requests

api_key = " " # Type your api key

url = f'https://api.minimax.io/v1/get_voice'
headers = {
    'authority': 'api.minimax.io',
    'Authorization': f'Bearer {api_key}'
}

data = {
    'voice_type': 'voice_cloning'
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data)
Response Parameters
voice_slotsarray
Includes all voices created during your subscribed voice plan period. Includes voice ID, voice description, and created time.
Show Properties
system_voicearray
Includes all available system voices. Includes voice ID, voice description, and voice name.
Show Properties
voice_cloningarray
Includes all cloned voices under the account. Includes voice ID, voice description, and created time.
Show Properties
voice_generationarray
Includes all voices created by voice design api. Includes voice ID, voice description, and created time.
Show Properties
music_generationarray
Includes all voices created by music generation api. Includes voice ID, instrumental id, and created time.
Show Properties
base_resparray
